scholarships.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at The American University in Cairo
scholarships.official_source: The American University in Cairo (AUC), in partnership with the Mastercard Foundation

existing.description: The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at AUC is a fully packaged graduate fellowship for African students, starting with the Spring 2027 cohort, under which AUC intends to award fellowships to 300 graduate students in fields that promote African economic development. It targets academically talented young Africans with leadership potential who face the highest economic and social barriers. The award is granted for the total study period of the degree on full-time enrolment, subject to review every semester for satisfactory academic performance, and it covers tuition, a stipend, a laptop, health insurance, university accommodation, local transport and, for fellows who do not already reside in Egypt, roundtrip airfare. Application requires two separate steps: the AUC graduate application and a dedicated Mastercard Foundation Scholars application.
eligibility: Currently residing in an African country and in possession of citizenship of at least one African country
Aged 35 or younger at the time of application
New graduate degree-seeking student satisfying AUC graduate admissions requirements; transfers are not eligible for this fellowship
Bachelor's degree with a minimum overall GPA of 3.2 on a 4.0 scale or equivalent
Women, forcibly displaced people and/or people living with disabilities are highly encouraged to apply
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be residing in an African country and hold citizenship of at least one African country, be aged 35 or younger at the time of application, be new graduate degree-seeking students meeting AUC graduate admissions requirements (transfers are not eligible), hold a bachelor's degree with a minimum overall GPA of 3.2 on a 4.0 scale or equivalent, and demonstrate financial need.
benefits: Tuition fees for nine credits per semester
Stipend during the fall and spring semesters
Medical service and health insurance fees
May cover remedial English modules or intensive English courses
Roundtrip airfare provided for fellows not residing in Egypt
Some candidates may be eligible for additional funding to cover research, publication fees and conference attendance
Special software subscriptions or IT purchases for those with disabilities
coverage: Tuition fees for nine credits per semester
Stipend during the fall and spring semesters
Medical service and health insurance fees
AUC bus subscription or travel allowance
Roundtrip airfare for fellows not residing in Egypt
May cover remedial English modules or intensive English courses
For some candidates, additional funding for research, publication fees and conference attendance
Special software subscriptions or IT purchases for those with disabilities
requirements: Must maintain a minimum GPA of 3.2
Fellows are assigned 12 hours per week of related academic work
A teaching assistantship mandatory training must be completed per University requirements if the fellow is involved in teaching assistantship duties
Fellows must respond to any reporting requests received from AUC or the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program by the communicated deadlines
Fellows must attend all supplemental workshops designed by the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program, including leadership, civic engagement and entrepreneurship workshops
You may be required to submit additional paperwork to be considered for this fellowship
documents: AUC graduate admissions application and its supporting documents
Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program online application
Additional paperwork as requested by AUC for fellowship consideration
application_method: Step 1: Submit the AUC online graduate application
Step 2: Submit the official Mastercard Foundation Scholars online application
Check the fellowship application cycle deadlines page before submitting
existing.selection_notes: The programme aims to offer fellowships to 300 graduate students in fields that promote African economic development, specifically targeting talented young Africans who lack access to quality education. Women, forcibly displaced people and people living with disabilities are highly encouraged to apply.
existing.best_fit: Academically strong African citizens under 35 with a minimum 3.2 GPA who need full financial support for an AUC graduate degree in Cairo and who can commit to full-time study plus 12 hours per week of related academic work.
existing.notes: Funding is NOT automatic on admission: applicants must complete both the AUC graduate application and the separate Mastercard Foundation Scholars application. Tuition coverage is published as 'tuition fees for nine credits per semester', and airfare is provided only for fellows who do not already reside in Egypt. The stipend amount is not published on the fellowship page, so no figure is recorded.
existing.duration: Total study period of the degree on full-time enrolment, reviewed every semester for satisfactory academic performance
existing.application_period: Spring 2027 cycle: applications open 7 October 2026 and close 2 November 2026 (deadlines page last updated 23 August 2026). Fall 2027 Cycle 1 opens 22 December 2026 and closes 17 January 2027; Fall 2027 Cycle 2 opens 6 April 2027 and closes 6 May 2027.
